title: [finding] `$exists` with a non-boolean comparand (`"yes"`, `1`) is accepted at every door and inverted on driver-memory: it returns the rows with NO value; the spec declares `$exists: z.boolean()`, and its `$null` twin is refused
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**. Finding class **(b)**. `reach:` measured at the public `engine.find` door on the in-memory driver by #20822 group 1's dev (`os-dev-report` 5915148713 on #20822, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`).

Filed by the `domain:engine` execution seat 1 (`session_01DEvba2nBuD4tWzfq8r8NFY`, `os-support-ai`). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

The object `px` has a text field `name`. Row `a` has `name` = `"won"`, and row `b` has `name` = null.

| `where` | driver-memory | right answer |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `{ name: { $exists: true } }` | `[a]` | `[a]` |
| `{ name: { $exists: "yes" } }` | **`[b]`**, the no-value row | refused, as `$null` is |
| `{ name: { $exists: 1 } }` | **`[b]`** | refused |

- The spec declares `$exists: z.boolean()` in `FieldOperatorsSchema` (`packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts`, about `:1590` and `:1670`). Yet `parseFilterAST` accepts a non-boolean, and no door refuses it.
- `driver-memory` lowers `val === true` to `$ne null` and anything else to `$eq null`, so a truthy flag **inverts**.
- The twin operator `$null` refuses a non-boolean on every driver (#5347; the refusal is worded in PR #20877).
- The retired reference matcher read `$exists` by truthiness. PR #20895 (#20822 group 1) pins the live path's answer, the divergence named in `memory-null-comparand-refusal.test.ts`.

Seam: `spec:FieldOperatorsSchema.$exists` (boolean) → `runtime:objectql` engine filter doors (no refusal) → `driver-memory` `normalizeFieldOperators` `$exists` arm. Measure the other drivers.

## Scope for whoever takes it (⛔ not a ruling)

- A non-boolean `$exists` is refused at the engine's comparand doors, in the `$null` refusal's words, on every driver. The spec already declares the boolean.
- Pins: `"yes"`, `1` and `"false"` refused on memory and SQLite, plus a `true` / `false` control.

## Dedupe

`mcp__github__search_issues`, repo-scoped, open and closed, in the act that filed this card:
- 「$exists non-boolean comparand refused truthy string inverted driver-memory exists yes returns null rows」: 24 hits. #20874 (open) is `$contains` on a stored array. #13357, #13553 and #13549 (closed) are reference-matcher null divergences. #20745, #20502, #20212, #19886 and #15104 (closed) are other comparand shapes. None is a non-boolean `$exists`.
